name: Minamoto Rui
source:
Position of the mark: On her right breast
Curse: [spoiler]Forbidden to make promises[/spoiler]
Gift: [spoiler]Enhanced physical strength[/spoiler]

Rui is homeless girl who lives alone like a stray dog. The abandoned building where she lived along with all of her belongings caught on fire so Tomo took her in his apartment for shelter. She considers [url=/c1789]Tomo[/url] as her closest friend and protects him from the molesting fingers of [url=/c1791]Atori[/url]. She easily trusts people as much as she easily gets hungry.
